universe: Every TQBR SECID in data/candles/moex_scan/universe_2026-10-30.json; only instruments with evaluable candles
baseline: buy 25% of account once at first evaluable next open and hold
dennis_rule: long after close exceeds prior 20 or 55 bar high, short after close below prior 20 or 55 bar low; exit long below prior 10 or 20 bar low, short above prior 10 or 20 bar high; entry fills next open; simplified close-confirmed adaptation without original intrabar stops, skip-after-win, pyramiding or N sizing
connors_rule: long only when close > SMA200 and Wilder RSI2 <5 or <10; exit when Wilder RSI2 >70; signal on close and fill next open; 200 bars on intraday variants rather than original 200 days
raschke_rule: long only; arm when ADX14 rises through 30 or 35 while close > EMA20 and EMA20 slopes up; first pullback within 10 bars that touches EMA20 and closes above it enters next open; exit on close above prior 20-bar high or below EMA20 minus one SMA ATR14; mechanical approximation of discretionary Holy Grail
position_policy: one position per ticker, 25% of each independent 1m RUB account, whole shares; no shared-portfolio inference
monthly_regime: ex post: monthly market return >5% growth, <-5% decline, else sideways if high-low range <=10% of first open, otherwise volatile_mixed; diagnostic only
selection: all outcomes retained; no numeric approval threshold; REVIEW_ONLY
limitations: intraday bar-count analogues are not original daily strategies
short borrow and availability not modeled
